queue.userDirective: Lord Rama, the perfect man, dharma's path, the great bow, forest exile, the bridge of devotion.
Shiva as Ardhanarishvara, the half-woman god, divine union, masculine and feminine, cosmic balance, one form.
Lord Krishna, the Vishwaroopa, the universal form, thousand suns, cosmic terror, all worlds in one.
Goddess Sita, born of the earth, golden deer, fire's purity, queen of Ayodhya, unwavering heart.
Lord Vishnu's avatar, Narasimha, the man-lion, twilight's edge, bursting from the pillar, protector's fury.
Lord Kartikeya, the six-faced god, peacock mount, general of the gods, the divine spear (Vel), slaying ignorance.
Lord Yama, god of death, the buffalo mount, cosmic justice, the book of deeds, the southern gate.
Goddess Ganga, the sacred river, descending from heaven, purifying waters, caught in Shiva's hair.
Lord Kubera, god of wealth, guardian of the north, yaksha king, the overflowing pot, mongoose companion.
Shiva as Bhairava, the terrible one, wandering ascetic, dog companion, skull-staff, guardian of Kashi.
Goddess Radha, divine love, Krishna's consort, the greatest Gopi, longing and union, Vrindavan's queen.
Lord Vayu, god of the wind, invisible force, breath of life (prana), Hanuman's father, swift as thought.
Lord Vishnu's avatar, Vamana, the dwarf brahmin, three giant steps, covering the cosmos, King Bali's offering.
Goddess Annapurna, giver of food, golden ladle, bowl of plenty, infinite kitchen, nourishment for all.
Lord Shani, planet Saturn, slow-moving judge, crow mount, karmic retribution, iron and shadow.
Hanuman as Panchamukhi, the five-faced, protector of all directions, combined power, ultimate guardian.
Goddess Chamunda, fierce form of Devi, emaciated body, drinking demon blood, graveyard dance.
Lord Brahma, the creator, emerging from Vishnu's lotus, four faces chanting the Vedas, the cosmic architect.
Lord Krishna, the child, Bala Krishna, stealing butter, the universe in his mouth, divine mischief.
The Trimurti, Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, the cosmic functions, creation, preservation, destruction, AUM.
Lord Vishnu's avatar, Parashurama, the warrior-sage, the axe of Shiva, immortal rage, ending the cycle.
Goddess Saraswati, the white river, flowing knowledge, the swan of discernment, goddess of speech (Vak).
Lord Indra, king of the gods, the thunderbolt (Vajra), elephant mount Airavata, battling Vritra, lord of rain.
Shiva as Neelkantha, the blue-throated, drinking the cosmic poison (Halahala), saving the universe, compassionate.
Goddess Lakshmi, the Ashta Lakshmi, eight forms of wealth, prosperity, knowledge, children, courage.
Lord Ganesha, the scribe, writing the epic Mahabharata, broken tusk as a pen, wisdom's flow.
Goddess Kali, standing on a calm Shiva, the void, timelessness, ultimate reality, beyond creation.
Lord Vishnu's avatar, Varaha, the cosmic boar, lifting the earth (Bhumi) from the primordial ocean, cosmic rescue.
Goddess Bhumi, the Earth, patience, fertility, the sacred cow, Vishnu's consort, life's foundation.
Lord Chandra, the Moon God, soma's glow, chariot of ten white horses, waxing and waning, lord of emotions.
Goddess Dhumavati, the widow goddess, smoke and decay, the crow banner, wisdom of non-attachment, solitude.
Lord Vishnu's avatar, Matsya, the great fish, saving Manu from the flood, the Vedas preserved in the water.
Nandi, the sacred bull, Shiva's gatekeeper, eternal waiting, pure devotion, the sound of the drum.
Goddess Ushas, the dawn, golden chariot, scattering the darkness, sister of night, new beginnings.
Lord Agni, the fire god, sacrificial messenger, two-faced, purifying flames, the link between worlds.
Goddess Parvati, the mountain's daughter, gentle mother, divine consort, penance and devotion, Ganesha's creator.
Lord Krishna, the charioteer, guiding Arjuna, the wisdom of the Gita, the battlefield of Kurukshetra.
Lord Vishnu's avatar, Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the churning mountain, the ocean of milk.
Goddess Ratri, the night, starry veil, cosmic rest, sister of dawn, the quiet mystery.
Rahu and Ketu, the shadow planets, severed head and body, cosmic serpents, eclipses, karma and destiny.
Lord Ayyappan, the jungle god, yogic posture, unity of Shiva and Vishnu, pilgrimage, tiger's milk.
Goddess Lalita Tripurasundari, the red beauty, sugarcane bow, flower arrows, supreme goddess, the Sri Yantra.
Lord Varuna, god of the cosmic ocean, the noose of the law (Rta), riding the sea monster Makara, the deep's observer.
Shiva, the great ascetic (Mahayogi), meditating on Kailash, covered in ash, serpent necklace, profound stillness.
Goddess Durga, the unconquerable, the citadel of strength, combined power of the gods, slaying Mahishasura.
Lord Hanuman, the healer, carrying the mountain of herbs (Sanjeevani), devotion's power, life-saving.
Lord Ganesha, lord of the digital age, mouse as a cursor, breaking through firewalls, wisdom of the web.
Goddess Saraswati, the digital muse, veena made of light, knowledge flowing as data streams, swan of code.
Shiva, the quantum dancer, particles and waves, the ring of fire as a data vortex, creation and destruction in code.
Lord Vishnu, the final avatar, Kalki, on a white horse, a server's comet-like sword, cleansing the corrupted code.
